text.tspan: I failed one quiz and learned more from that
than the ones I passed.
The part dashboards miss is the human
friction. I failed one quiz and learned more
from that than the ones I passed.
Adult learning works when life logistics are
respected.
Curious how others handle this.
Being a beginner again is a professional
skill.
Group projects taught me as much about
collaboration as content.
Community accelerates learning more than solo
grind does.
A librarian helped me find sources I would
have missed entirely.
